mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(member_id) FROM member) AS totalMember, (SELECT COUNT(board_id) FROM board) AS totalBoard, (SELECT COUNT(member_id) FROM member WHERE created_at >= CURDATE() AND created_at < CURDATE() + INTERVAL 1 DAY ) AS todayMember, (SELECT COUNT(board_id) FROM board WHERE created_at >= CURDATE() AND created_at < CURDATE() + INTERVAL 1 DAY ) AS todayBoard
